# Seven Eighty Three (783)

> An independent systems laboratory specializing in matter and body architecture.

783 maps signal loss between leadership intent and organizational behavior across code, text, physical space, and behavior. It builds infrastructure that closes that loss and conceives, builds, and sells companies whole.

## Identity

- Founder & Principal Architect: Argelys Samuel Oriach.
- Location: Brooklyn, New York. Available worldwide.
- Contact: argelys@seveneightythree.com.
- WILD-LAKE is the research studio and home of the Talent Architect practice; it is not for sale.
- 783 is the first company built inside the studio and is open to investment and acquisition.

## Capabilities

- **Systems Diagnostics**: A high-density audit of how your organization actually runs, across code, text, physical space, and behavior. Every engagement starts here.
- **Executive Advisory**: Fractional leadership and strategic counsel that align your organizational structure, physical systems, and digital architecture.
- **Infrastructure Design**: Custom systems built on the Universe API, which works below the query layer to dictate how AI and search engines index you.
- **Venture Building**: Companies conceived, built, and sold whole: concept, domain, brand, and technical infrastructure, ready for acquisition.

## Research

The Lab Funding Prospectus describes a 2026 pre-seed research round and 12 months of field work. The research asks whether tacit decision-making signals can be observed, documented, and translated into repeatable tools. Proposed outputs include field notes, case studies, a founder-calibration prototype, and a publishable framework. These are proposed research outcomes, not completed products.
